selector.champion: Linear or annular lupus erythematosus panniculitis of the scalp (LALPS)
selector.rationale: The patient's presentation of an asymptomatic, arc-shaped, depressed skin groove on the scalp with localized linear hair loss and the histopathologic findings of lymphocytic infiltrates and lobular panniculitis support LALPS. The presence of granular deposition of IgG, IgA, IgM, C3, C1q, and fibrinogen in the dermal blood vessels also points towards an autoimmune process like LALPS.

rejected.label: Morphea
rejected.why: Morphea typically presents with sclerotic plaques and does not usually involve the scalp or hair loss to this extent.

rejected.label: Lichen Planopilaris
rejected.why: Lichen Planopilaris is characterized by the presence of broken hairs and a different dermoscopic pattern, which was not seen in this patient.
